title: Auto Farm
features:
⚠️ Warning Do not use this in Daily Mode or Modifiers Mode because they track your game completion time.

Aimia — Depth Spelunking
An auto-farm hub for Depth Spelunking. Run it, enter your key, turn on Auto Run, and it handles the rest.

[Function]
Auto Run — clears tasks, returns to the elevator, and descends to your set floor on its own
Speed Mode — Default / Master (Master is ~3.5× faster; if the server can't keep up it drops back to Default automatically)
Exit Floor — pick the floor to leave on
Task Camera — point the camera at each task (toggle on/off)

[How to use]
Run the script → enter your key → open the Auto Task tab and hit Auto Run → set your exit floor under Run Control → Exit Floor. Done — no need to press E yourself.

[Update]
• Supports every task type, hooked automatically — no re-running between floors
• Added Speed Mode (Master fast mode)
• Choose to clear only what's required, or every task on the floor
• Set your own exit floor

[Fixed]
• Your character no longer disappears while doing a task

[Notes]
• With no run active, Auto Run stays idle and does nothing
• Keys last about 12 hours — renew through the key window when it expires
